about_the_game:
▼Story

You are a self-proclaimed "stay-at-home security officer" living alone in a small apartment.
You have no steady job—your days consist of browsing the internet, playing solitaire, and confronting the pigeons that visit your balcony.

But one day, a letter from your mother brings your peaceful routine to an end:
"Starting next month, I’ll stop sending you money. It’s time for you to support yourself."

With only a short grace period left, you must face reality.
Will you take your first steps into the world... or cling to your current lifestyle?
Your daily choices shape the branching storyline that follows.

▼Game Overview

The game progresses in in-game days, not real time.
Each day, you’ll click around your room to choose how you spend your time.

  • Respond to the doorbell and talk to visitors

  • Chase away pigeons on the balcony

  • Escape reality by gaming on your PC

  • Take on daily chores like taking out the trash

After completing your actions for the day, time advances to the next day.
Depending on your decisions, the story branches and evolves.
This is a 2D, multi-ending slice-of-life simulation with a twist.

▼Controls

  • Mouse-only gameplay

    • Left-click to examine objects and characters in your room
